title: Three tests fail intermittently on the macOS runner and block the required check
input: Three tests fail intermittently on the macOS runner and block the required check 'check (macos-latest)' on pull requests 38, 39 and 40, none of which touches their code: tests/unit/knowledge-resolve.test.ts ('migration 7: dropping a repository's rows > a repository whose folder is gone loses its rows to rebuildAll', ENOENT lstat of a projects folder), tests/unit/knowledge-index.test.ts ('rebuildAll > maps a project folder through its manifest, reports orphans, forgets folders that are gone'), and tests/integration/team-mirror.test.ts:762 ('a throw outside the per-revision blocks is recorded in mirror.last': runMirror did not throw under a read-only parent, and reported ENOENT on an entry's temporary file instead). All three remove or lose a directory and then expect a precise outcome. Find the cause on macOS and make the tests, or the code if it is at fault, deterministic.
routeReasons: personal data in lines not read for risk (test or excluded): email (tests/unit/knowledge-maintenance.test.ts)

criteria.text: Every git call of the knowledge store carries maintenance.auto=false, maintenance.autoDetach=false and gc.autoDetach=false; the trace git itself writes of a store write, taken through the stub's traceTo, holds one git maintenance run --auto --quiet command for each commit, started by the runner after the commit, and no git command with --detach; a trace without the maintenance command fails the test.
A mirror run that commits: every git call carries the three settings, and git's own trace holds the runner's maintenance command after each commit and no --detach.
A maintenance call that fails, and one that passes the timeout, do not fail the write: the entry is written and committed, the tree equals HEAD, and the failure is in the log.
The tests' own git reads maintenance.auto as false.

ADR 0024 and CLAUDE.md name the three settings and the runner's own maintenance call; ADR 0024 says in both places it speaks of housekeeping that it still runs, started by the runner after a commit in the foreground, and keeps the known limit open: unchecked files inside the folders of objects/, housekeeping that removes and rewrites files there, the sync part to close it.
tests/unit/knowledge-repo.test.ts, tests/unit/knowledge-git-host.test.ts and tests/integration/team-mirror.test.ts pass as before.

A lease lost at the maintenance call: in the store, the write returns, the entry is written and committed and the tree equals HEAD; in the mirror, the run stops with its lost-lease error, as at any other git call.

With work due (two loose objects in the folder git samples, and gc.auto=1 given by the host), the runner's call after a commit, carrying the three settings, packs the loose objects before commitPaths returns.

decisions.question: How does the product's git runner treat git's automatic maintenance, which a commit starts detached?
decisions.default: In the foreground: maintenance.autoDetach=false and gc.autoDetach=false on every call
decisions.answer: Em primeiro plano (Recomendado): maintenance.autoDetach=false and gc.autoDetach=false on every call; git keeps compacting, inside the commit, and nothing runs after it

checklists.reason: A fix inside the one git runner's settings: no endpoint, permission, payment, upload, migration, third party, link, deletion path of the product, merge or screen changes

removedCriteria.text: Every git call of the knowledge store carries maintenance.autoDetach=false and gc.autoDetach=false, and a write of the store, traced by git itself, runs no git command with --detach.
Every git call of a mirror run carries the two settings, and a run that commits, traced by git itself, runs no git command with --detach.
The tests' own git reads maintenance.autoDetach and gc.autoDetach as false.
ADR 0024 and CLAUDE.md name the two settings, and ADR 0024 no longer says that the store leaves git's housekeeping as it is.
tests/unit/knowledge-repo.test.ts, tests/unit/knowledge-git-host.test.ts and tests/integration/team-mirror.test.ts pass as before.
